item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Report shows Amazon, Walmart shopping bots avoid data on products ‘Made in USA’
item.description: A new report has found that Amazon and Walmart's shopping bots largely avoided or said they couldn't access data on products ‘Made in USA.’

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump's vaccine executive order draws bipartisan criticism, pushback from doctors
item.description: Public health experts and Republican lawmakers are criticizing Trump's executive order to split the MMR vaccine, saying it lacks scientific support and could put children at risk.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bradenton police need help identifying victim of hit-and-run crash from Aug. 8
item.description: Bradenton Police said on Aug. 11 that the victim remains in the hospital, but he is unable to speak and cannot be identified by his fingerprints.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Colombian business owner checks on family after deadly earthquake
item.description: Edgar Vallejo owns Cali Viejo in Brandon. He said it is devastating to see the destruction in Colombia, especially because his family is still there.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tropical wave's chances for development increase in Atlantic
item.description: We are down to two areas that FOX 13 meteorologists are watching in the tropics. The first is a trough of low pressure in the Central Subtropical Atlantic located about 750 miles east-northeast of Bermuda.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete Beach artist turns paintings into fundraiser for mom’s brain surgery
item.description: St. Pete Beach artist and grad student Makaila Zelin is raising money for her mom’s $45,000 brain surgery.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 4 'violent' Mexican cartel members accused of trading drugs for military weapons in Czech Republic: DOJ
item.description: Four members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, one of Mexico's most powerful and violent drug organizations, are facing federal charges after they were arrested in the Czech Republic. The men are accused of trying to buy military weapons with drugs trafficked into the United States, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office.
